book.name: 2 TIMOTIUS
book.title: Nyovara Wao Jirum Paulus Po Ratoe Timotius Ai 2 TIMOTIUS

content: Paulus po kove ranutu Timotius ai

Risyirati Paulus, syo nyovara waowe so ratoe syo ranutugore Timotius nai, winyamo sya arikainyo inanuga no nai. Risyamo Yesus Kristus po inatutir mamaisyo Amisye apa bekere rai indamu syo Apa urairije ravovo vatane mai: purairive pare Po kovo nuge nuganuije raunanto vatano wanave Yesus Kristus aije mansai.
Syare kove muno muinye muno saumane no no Injayo Amisy muno wama Amisy Yesus Kristus no wasautan tenambe.
Vemo nsamane nyo Amisy Yesus aura kakavimbe nora
Timotius, risyo kove raura seo Amisye aijo nai. Risambayambe Ai inanuga ngkakavimbe rautan, maisyare muno sya aneno wusyine usambayambe Ai wemaisy. Namane rinit ribe sambayambe nai tutir.
Aro! Timotius, rinaemeno masyoto wusyinoe rai arono winanimaumbe ti nami ngkaruge ntende weye syo napaya ti wibuin no. Weti ribeker syakare syo naen akato indamu inanayanambe.
Syo raen winyamo nyanave tugaive, maisyare muno nya aneno Loisa muno nangkoyo Eunike yamaisy. Syo raen aya anaveo Yesus Kristus aije no winy nanuga rai tavona.

Wemi mbewar syare naemen irati kovo vambunino Amisye po raugaje naije rai, wemirati nande nai arono syo inaneme raijaseo ntamijo naijoe. Weti nanuga ntenam nyo kovo vambunine wato raveano anakero Amisye raijar.

Weramu vemo njani nora, weye Amisye apa Anawayo Vambunin po raugaje wansai mamo Mo wansanuga yanive raunande ramu, yara Mo wama vambunine muno muinye raunande, muno no wansai tutir ti wambambunino wamo wama ana wandave muno wandaura raeranande indamu vemo ayao kakaije ntipu rai nora.

Vemo winsamane nyo wama Amisy Yesus aura kakavimbe nanto vatano wantatukambe Aije mai nora. Muno vemo winsamane rinai weye rituna no tanoano makova rai wenora. Syanapatambe Yesus Kristus ai wemi mbewar inausiso makova. Syare nyanatatayaube indamu winsiuri tavon weye nyo Ayao Kove ravov. Indati Amisye po vambunine raugaje nai indamu natawandi rai.

Amisye po wansapaya irati ayao kakaije rai muno Po wansawain indamu wamamo Apa kawasaeyo apaura wansai. Weramu wama ana wandave wemi Amisye daen ti pare apaura wansai omamo jewen, yara Po rave mamaisyo taune Apa bekere muno Apa kove rai. Weye arono munije so ranari rainy, Amisye po rapatimu indamu Yesus Kristus po apa kove raugaje wansai.

Soamo Apa kove raroron kakavimbe weye Yesus Kristus de to, Po wansapaya irati wama ayao kakaije rai. Yesus po wene ama vambunine rapinde to, muno Po kovo nuge nuganui raugavo vatano nanawirati wanave Apa Ayao Kove raije mansai.
Risyamo vatano Yesus Kristus po inapatimu, Po inatutir indamu syo Apa Ayao Kove ravov muno syo vatane mansanyao.

Wemi mbewar soamo risiuri no tanoano makova rai. Weramu risamane ramu, weye syo raen tugae Napi syanave Ai opamo Amisye pije. Muno inanuga ntindimu Ai, syanave Wepi bambunin Po inaeranande tutir ava nto Apa masyoto pakare no mine vone so rai.

Timotius, syare ananyao tugae wemirati syo raugaje nai mbe unanuive indamu nya ananyao mo sya ramaisy. Muno syare nyo nya anave raijar matuve muno nyo muinye rarorono vatane mai, weye wimbe intabove Yesus Kristus ai.

Amisye po apa ananyao tugae raugaje nai indamu nyo raeranande. Muno Anawayo Vambunin, omi ntuna no wansanuga rai, Mo vambunine raugaje nai, weti syare nyo ananyao umaso raeranande kobe indamu vemo ayao angkarije nande rai jinya.
Nyo raen Pigerusa pe Ermogenesa pe arakovo kaijo una no propinsi Asia makirive rinai tenambe to.

Weramu arakovo Onesiporusa pamo bekobe rinai. Weti ibe sambayambe indamu Amisye aemeno Onesiporus apa yavaruga mansai. Nyo raen arono wusyinoe Onesiporusa panapatambe manakoeve rinai no munijo Epesus. Muno arono Onesiporusa de no munijo Roma so rai, po inakani yava nande inai to. Po inaen rimakova irati vatano mamune mansarijat no tanoano makova rai, weramu opamo samane rinaije ramu, yara po inapan ama susye manui, ti inanuga mbambunin akato. Weti ribe sambayambe indamu Amisye indati aemeno ai ti Po kove raugaje ai arono masyoto Po mangke rapatimugo vatano mine so mansai.
